comparison: Same benchmark executable source, dependencies, parameters and seeds. Baseline binary saved before HNSW changes; current binary includes duplicate-aware selection, f32 pruning scores, cached norms and reusable writer scratch.
scope: Synthetic uniform vectors; macOS arm64; machine not isolated. Runs performed without concurrent Cargo builds/tests. Report medians, not universal speedups. No RSS measurement. Euclidean query time increased 5-8%; initial recall rose from 0.9975 to 1.0, post-reinsert recall stayed 0.9975.
